FN-QNRX341-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 203
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 203 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by approximately $5,850 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on
information provided by the entity, by exempting High Socks for Hope, Incorporated from
paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the
estimated annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information
provided by the entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local
sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill:
County Funds ($4,390)
Municipal Funds ($7,310)
